Sesa Goa Ltd. has informed the Exchange that: "Sesa Goa Limited (the "Company") announces the final terms of the previously announced launch of an offering of Foreign Currency Convertible Bonds ("FCCBs"). The size of the offering is US$ 500 million. The FCCBs will have a coupon of 5% per annum, payable semi-annually in arrear and will be convertible into equity shares of the Company. The conversion price has been set at Rs. 346.88 per share, representing a premium of 28% to the reference price of Rs. 271.00 per share. Proceeds from the offering will be used to expand the Company's mining operations, for exploration for new resources, and to further develop its pig iron and metallurgical coke operations. Use of proceeds will be in accordance with end-use restrictions specified in the External Commercial Borrowing regulations issued by the Reserve Bank of India. The proposed offering of the FCCBs is subject to passing a special resolution of the shareholders of the Company (at least 75% present and voting) at an Extraordinary General Meeting of the Company scheduled to be held on 20 October 2009 and other customary closing conditions. Settlement is expected to occur shortly thereafter, once all necessary approvals have been obtained. Goldman Sachs (Asia) LLC and Morgan Stanley & Co. International plc are acting as the joint bookrunners for the offering".

The proceeds of this FCCB offering are intended to be used for financing the growth plans of Sesa, including an increase in the mining capacity through organic and inorganic routes. Sesa Goa Ltd. has informed the Exchange that an EGM of the company will be held on January 25,2005 to transact the following business:1)To increase the Authorised Share Capital of the Company from Rs.20,00,00,000(Rupees Two Hundred Million) divided into 2,00,00,000 equity shares of Rs.10 each to Rs. 50,00,00,000(Rupees Five Hundred Million) divided into 5,00,00,000 equity shares of Rs.10 each,by creation of 3,00,00,000 new equity shares of Rs.10 each and that such shares will rank pari passu in all respects with the existing equity shares of the Company and consequently the existing Clause V of the Memorandum of Association of the Company be and hereby altered by deleting the same and substituting in placeand instead thereof,the following as new Clause V. 2)Pursuant to the provisions of article 165 of the Articles of Association of the Company and recommendation of the BODs and subject to the guidelines issued by SEBI and such approvals as may be required in this regard, consent of the members be and is hereby accorded to the BODs of the company(hereinafter referred to as the board which expression shall be deemed to include a Committee of Directors duly authorized in this behalf) for capitalization of such of General Reserves of the Company as may be considered necessary by the Board for the purpose of issue of bonus shares of Rs.10 each, credited as fully paid-up shares to the holders of existing equity shares of the company whose names appear in the Register of Members on such date as may be fixed in this regard ,in the proportion of  One existing equity share held by them.

Sesa Goa Ltd. has informed the Exchange that the BOD at their meeting held on December 17, 2004, have taken the following decisions : 1) Interim dividend for the FY 2004-2005 has been declared @ Rs.5/- per share (i.e.50%) and Record Date for the purpose has been fixed on January 07, 2005; 2) Increase the Authorised Share Capital of the Company from Rs.200 million to Rs.500 million subject to the approval of the Shareholders; 3) Issue of Bonus Shares of Rs.10/- each, credited as fully paid-up shares to the holders of existing equity shares of the Company in the proportion of One Equity share for every One existing equity share held by them. The Record Date in respect of the Bonus Issue will be fixed after the Bonus Issue is approved by the Shareholders at the EGM; 4) Convene EGM of the shareholders of the Company on January 25, 2005 for approval of Shareholders for increase in Authorised Share Capital and issue of Bonus Shares.

Sesa Goa Ltd. has informed the Exchange that the BOD at their meeting held on December 17, 2004, have declared an Interim dividend @ Rs.5/- per share (i.e.50%) for the FY 2004-2005 and Record Date for the purpose has been fixed on January 07, 2005.

Sesa Goa Ltd. has informed the Exchange that at the Court convened meeting of the shareholders of the Company held on October 05, 2004, a resolution was passed unanimously by the members present at the meeting approving and agreeing to the scheme of amalgamation of Sesa Kembla Coke Co. Ltd. with the Company.
